name: readiness
caption: Readiness of the characterized datasets for reconstruction under the fixed configuration, together with the measured values on which each verdict rests. Readiness names the class defined in Section 6.1, with ripe, ripening or unripe in brackets. Registered is the share of frames that the largest model holds, and stability the number of registered runs out of the repeated runs of the same input, or single run where the input was not repeated. PSNR is the range on the every-8th split over the n reconstructed sequences of the dataset. Scale anchor names the external reference shipped with the dataset and, where a reconstructed camera path could be aligned to it, the alignment error, which includes the error of the reference itself. The limit column names the measured property that sets the class or, for a ripe dataset, the caveat that applies to it, and the evidence column gives the tables, figures and sections from which the row is taken. Dashes mark values that do not apply to a dataset without registered imagery.
